cohort: Women aged 18-50 who visited the hospital at 6-weeks postpartum for a regular checkup, excluding those with a history of mood disorders, antidepressant use, or systemic illnesses (hypothyroidism, epilepsy, diabetes, hypertension).
finding: Lower vitamin B12 and combined B12 scores, along with higher MMA and 5-methyl THF levels, were significantly associated with probable postpartum depression.
